items.title: A Happy Team Can Create Nothing: Measure Team Value, Not Mood
items.summary: PEAKTEAMS is a free, anonymous 12-minute team survey that scores your team's value from 0 to 100, not its mood and flags the hidden concerns others miss.Take the Peakteams Team Assessment Tool at https://www.peakteams.io/ and read the leadership style assessment at https://www.peakteams.io/resources/leadership-style-assessment.
